location: Results, Subscale/Syndrome Comparisons, p. 52 (PDF p. 53); Table 5, p. 57 (PDF p. 58)
quote:
Attention Problems scale was also significantly correlated with the ASCA Attention

Deficit Hyperactivity syndrome (r = .66, p < .01)
reason: For the target comparison between the BASC-3 TRS-C Attention Problems scale and the ASCA Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity syndrome, the correlation is r = .66 (Table 5 and printed p. 52). The shipped value of 0.79 mistakenly came from the global composite correlation between BASC-3 Externalizing Problems and ASCA Overactivity on the same page.
